dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What time shall we meet on Friday?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm ʃæl wiː ˈmiːt ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sure. Where shall we meet? Inside the mall?
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ˈwɛr ʃæl wiː ˈmiːt? ˌɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈmɔːl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's very crowded inside. Let's meet outside, at the entrance.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈvɛri ˈkraʊdɪd ˌɪnˈsaɪd. ˈlɛts ˈmiːt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd, ət ði ˈɛntrəns.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Which entrance? The mall has three!
dialogue.reading: ˈwɪtʃ ˈɛntrəns? ðə ˈmɔːl ˈhæz ˈθriː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The one near the train station. Take Exit 3.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈwʌn ˈnɪr ðə ˈtreɪn ˌsteɪʃən. ˈteɪk ˈɛɡzɪt ˈθriː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. And if it rains, shall we wait inside?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd ɪf ɪt ˈreɪnz, ʃæl wiː ˈweɪt ˌɪnˈsaɪd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, let's. See you on Friday!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈlɛts. ˈsiː juː ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ!
